item.tib: bka' gsang mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud gu ru'i thugs bcud las mkha' 'gro seng gdong khros ma'i rgyud las me zhags khro chu'i zhun khung
item.coloph: ces pa'i tshul 'di ni gsang ba seng gdong khros ma'i rgyud las/ me zhags khro chu'i zhun khung 'di phyi rabs don du mkha' spyod pa o rgyan byang chub rdo rje dal (rtsal) gyis sbyar ba'o//
